in_marathi.name: Trilokanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Three Worlds
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trilokanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trilokanath is a name of Lord Shiva, meaning 'Lord of the Three Worlds'. He is revered as the ruler of the universe, who maintains the balance between creation, preservation, and destruction.
